name: Workflow
definition: Orchestrates several activities, each consuming the outputs of earlier ones, as one executable whole. One execution of it is a workflow run.
rationale: Parent for the workflow-level types (mangrove, algae-bloom and MoM workflows, WorkflowRun); no generic type covered orchestration.

name: Catalog export
definition: Assembles the results of an analysis into a catalog of items with their assets, for example a STAC Catalog.
rationale: Parent for the STAC catalog assembly steps of the water-bodies and mangrove workflows.

name: Model inference
definition: Applies a trained model to input data to produce predictions or derived data; the counterpart of model training.
rationale: Parent for InferenceExecution (CRIM); referenced as an undefined type by other sources.
